headline: JSW Energy convenes NCLT-directed shareholder meeting
sum: JSW Energy Limited has notified the NSE of an NCLT-convened equity shareholders' meeting scheduled for 20 July 2026, pursuant to a direction from the National Company Law Tribunal's Mumbai Bench.
detail: JSW Energy Limited formally informed the NSE of an NCLT-convened meeting of equity shareholders scheduled for 20 July 2026. The summons issued to shareholders derives from the National Company Law Tribunal's Mumbai Bench direction, a procedural gate that typically accompanies schemes of arrangement under the Companies Act 2013 (merger, demerger, reconstruction) or IBC-driven creditor/equity reallocation. The notice constitutes a material corporate event triggering stock exchange disclosure and shareholder communication obligations under SEBI Listing Rules.
